title: What does APR mean?
takeaways: APR is the yearly rate before compounding.
APY includes the effect of compounding.

data.simpleMeaning: The interest rate for a whole year, before any compounding is counted.
data.roleHere: It is the r in our formula when interest is added once a year.
data.connectsTo: APY, which shows what you really earn after compounding.
data.example: A savings account with a 5% APR adds $50 to $1,000 in one year.

caption: APR stands for annual percentage rate, the yearly rate before compounding.
